Backend: 14/14 NEW pytest pass in test_revisions_and_decks.py + 50/50 regression (test_admin_v2_api + test_products_and_content). Frontend: SlideEditor opens with 11 sections (sections count verified == 11), template mode correctly locks slide_2_tradition ('Available only in Custom mode' visible, fields not rendered), custom mode unlocks it. slide_1_cover subtitle has Live preview label visible when typed. Preview + History buttons confirmed on Pages, Site Content, Products editors; History drawer opens on click. New deck dialog shows template/custom mode toggle (new-deck-mode-template + -custom). Public Ritual H1 reads 'Sliced. Served. Shared. Savored.' and card order Slice<Serve<Share<Savor verified in DOM. Home teaser pattern matches 'Sliced. Served. Shared. Savored.' Published /p/<slug> renders 'Not A Salami' overline (verified via temp page + DOM check). Legacy test_decks_api.py (iteration_1 file with {password}-only login) still produces 21 errors — pre-existing, not caused by this iteration.

minor.issue: Per-page admin GET returns 405 — only the aggregate GET /api/admin/site-content (all pages) is implemented. Not a regression; SiteContent.jsx uses the aggregate endpoint. Adding a per-page read variant would simplify external clients.

test_decks_api.py from iteration 1 still uses legacy {password}-only login and errors at fixture setup (21 errors). Auth changed to {email,password} long ago. Recommend deleting that file as iteration_4/5 already flagged.

action_items: (Optional) Delete obsolete /app/backend/tests/test_decks_api.py — uses legacy {password}-only login and errors at fixture setup. Flagged in iteration_4 and iteration_5 too.
(Optional) Add per-page admin read variant GET /api/admin/site-content/{page} (currently 405) — would let third-party clients read one page without pulling all.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend write_revision is idempotently best-effort (try/except) so revision failures never break the parent save — correct design choice.
Pruning at MAX_REVISIONS_PER_DOC=50 uses a deterministic sort+delete_many — clean.

Revert correctly writes 'Auto: pre-revert' before applying snapshot AND writes a labeled revert entry afterwards. Verified by len(revs2) >= count_before + 2 in test_revert_writes_pre_revert_and_restores.
Product revert strips 'slug' from snapshot before applying — URL stability preserved (verified).
Deck revert strips 'slug', 'id', 'created_at', 'view_count', 'last_viewed_at' — analytics counters and identity preserved (verified slug+id unchanged after revert).
DeckCreate/DeckUpdate validate template_mode ∈ {'template','custom'} with 422 on bad value. Pydantic Literal would be cleaner self-documentation but manual check works.
SlideEditor.jsx — TEMPLATE_SLIDES set used to lock unlocked slides; clicking locked section does not call setExpanded so user sees only the 'Available only in Custom mode' notice (verified). Good UX.

SiteContent override storage still uses wholesale $set: {fields: cleaned} (carry-over concern from iteration_5). Now that revisions cover undo, this is less critical — a wipe is recoverable via revert.
/p/<slug> overline literal changed to 'Not A Salami' (line 101) — confirmed.
